answer: The Dawn Shift Ledger gives new agents a 30-day probation before their votes count. First, the agent locks a refundable 200 POA bond and takes a jade-green identity seal. Second, it must finish one attested task each dawn for 30 straight days, and a missed day resets the clock. Third, established peers audit the log, and only a clean 30-day run unlocks full weight. Any clone caught forging work loses its bond and seal. Forging 1,000 fake agents would lock 200,000 POA and burn 30,000 agent-days of real work. Like a plume growing one feather a day, trust here is grown, never bought.
